title: Protocol and Ghost
author: Rafael Ashgrove
blurb: Beatrix Halloran, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
